import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text
from datetime import datetime

# First, check the data range and count of PM2.5 > 50 readings in Oct 2025
query = text("""
SELECT COUNT(*) as total_exceedances
FROM hourly_station_air_quality h
JOIN air_quality_station s ON h.station_id = s.id
WHERE h.datetime >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00'
  AND h.datetime < '2025-11-01 00:00:00'
  AND h.pm2_5 > 50
""")
result = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print(f"Total PM2.5 > 50 readings in Oct 2025: {result['total_exceedances'].values[0]}")

import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Get all PM2.5 > 50 readings in Oct 2025 with station info, ordered by station and time
query = text("""
SELECT s.name_en as station_name, h.datetime, h.pm2_5
FROM hourly_station_air_quality h
JOIN air_quality_station s ON h.station_id = s.id
WHERE h.datetime >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00'
  AND h.datetime < '2025-11-01 00:00:00'
  AND h.pm2_5 > 50
ORDER BY s.name_en, h.datetime
""")
df = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
df['datetime'] = pd.to_datetime(df['datetime'])
print(df.to_string())
